title: Explicit even filtration quotient
statement: For a commutative ring A, a nonpositive bicomplex K, and short exact complexes S_i whose middle objects are identified with column -i, fix j, an index type I in the universe of A, and degrees d:I→ℤ. If the first endpoint of S_j is isomorphic to the coproduct of single-degree copies of A in degrees d(i), the categorical cokernel of the explicit inclusion F_(2j) → F_(2j+1) of [lem-pc-derived-total-filtration-stable] is isomorphic to that coproduct in degrees d(i)-j. No choice of splittings or decompositions for other endpoints is required.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09KP, successive quotients of the alternating column filtration
proof_origin.note: Explicit chain map, componentwise isomorphism criterion, and shift/coproduct transport.

proof.text: Construct the quotient chain map from the explicit components and their proved commutation equation. Degreewise bijectivity makes each component an isomorphism, and hence the complex map is an isomorphism. Apply the shift functor to the given endpoint isomorphism, transport the coproduct through that functor, and use the single-functor shift isomorphism to reindex each degree d(i) to d(i)-j.
